source_scene: POM: she waves her POM-poms, and they are two red APPLES.
PEHSH: she PESHters everyone for the PEACH; sounds like PEACH with the end chopped off.
oh-RAHNZH: an ORANGE, said the French way, "oh-RANZH!", like a surprised oh.
bah-NAHN: the monkey shouts "BA-NAN!" with his mouth full of BANANA.
PWAHR: P + WAR: the PEAR stands ready for WAR on the counter.
FREHZ: a STRAWBERRY so big it needs a whole PHRASE to describe it.
suh-REEZ: a whole SERIES of CHERRIES, pair after pair.
oh-LEEV: OLIVES that won't LEAVE the bowl: OH, LEAVE already!
ah-MAHND: A MOUND of ALMONDS in the little sack.
PAHY: a PIE with a STRAW stuck in it: sip your PIE through la PAILLE, the STRAW.
FRWEE: FREE FRUIT! take a basket.
see-TROHN: SEE the LEMON sit on its THRONE: see-TRONE.
reh-ZAN: not a RAISIN yet: a fresh bunch of GRAPES (raisins are just dried grapes).
muh-LOHN: a MELON so round it rolls a LONG way: muh-LONG!
ah-bree-KOH: the APRICOT wears A BRIE-COAT, a cheese-soft COAT for winter.
